sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Dante Vale used the spell in the Temple of Thor to place Tersly in a bubble in order to get him out of harm's way whilst fighting Fenris. He floated over to Sophie Casterwill who popped the bubble and helped him up. [Two Powers Become One]

Sophie used the spell to remove and destroy traps left by Klaus in a cabinet in his lab. She later used it to block a stairway with a bookcase, bolstered by Dante's Stopglue power. [The Bookshop Hunter]

In the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, Sophie used the spell to trap Impet in a bubble before Sabriel slammed it into a Suit. [Memory Lane]

Zhalia Moon used the spell to take the Ring of Behemoth from Hippolyta. [Ladies' Choice]

After her parachute was compromised by attacks from Wilder's Suits, Sophie used Bubblelift to stop herself from falling. The bubble was hit by another attack however, leaving her to cling to a branch of a tree. [Doorway to Huntik]

Lok Lambert used the spell to attach Dendras' dragons to Incubane whilst fighting Wilder on Avalon. [Knight of the Willblade] 

Sophie used the spell to land a bin on top of a Silent Soldier in Rotterdam, Netherlands. [Den vs Harrison]

Lok used it in conjunction with Dendras again in Medusa's Cave to neutralize Vulcana whilst ambushing Kiel. [Zhalia's Mission]

Sophie Casterwill used Bubblelift to create a water balloon to throw at Den Fears whilst attempting to tutor him. He later attempted to do the same but she caught him. [Lok's Leadership]

Dante Vale used the spell to remove the Amulet of Legion from around Rassimov's neck and kick it towards Lok who destroyed it using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]

Scarlet Byrne used a red version of the spell on herself so she could safely land as she jumped off a Scramjet during the final battle at the Blood Spiral Base. [Lok and the Betrayer]

full_text:
Bubblelift is a spell that allows the casting Seeker to create a blue bubble around an object and then lift it into the air. The spell is useful for moving heavy objects or for isolating Titans or other people. This bubble, however, can be popped easily by attacks from outside.

== History ==
Dante Vale used the spell in the Temple of Thor to place Tersly in a bubble in order to get him out of harm's way whilst fighting Fenris. He floated over to Sophie Casterwill who popped the bubble and helped him up. [Two Powers Become One]

Sophie used the spell to land a bin on top of a Silent Soldier in Rotterdam, Netherlands. [Den vs Harrison]

Lok used it in conjunction with Dendras again in Medusa's Cave to neutralize Vulcana whilst ambushing Kiel. [Zhalia's Mission]

Sophie Casterwill used Bubblelift to create a water balloon to throw at Den Fears whilst attempting to tutor him. He later attempted to do the same but she caught him. [Lok's Leadership]

Dante Vale used the spell to remove the Amulet of Legion from around Rassimov's neck and kick it towards Lok who destroyed it using the Willblade. [The Spiral Mark]
